scope: Paired permutation test on dev_confirm (n=6,417; development-confirmation split)
caveats: McNemar and group sign-flip tests evaluate Accuracy; this script supplements them with Macro-F1 paired group permutation tests
Group bootstrap intervals are retained from t2_score.py
E1/E2 comparison family defined prior to Tier-2 training
dev_confirm serves as a development-confirmation set for mechanism analysis
No retraining, no model edits, and no access to held-out post-2023 records
